# ELLIXORRR

Ellixorrr is a technology services company helping businesses build and manage their digital presence through website development, application development, business automation, and custom solutions. We work around each business's actual requirements and provide ongoing support and improvements after launch.

## Services

- **Websites**: Fast, well-structured websites and online stores that load quickly, rank properly, and turn visitors into enquiries and orders.
- **Applications**: Applications shaped around your operations — portals, dashboards, and internal tools — instead of forcing your process into someone else's box.
- **Automations**: Workflow automation and AI agents that quietly take over repetitive work — follow-ups, data entry, reporting — so your team can focus on customers.
- **Custom Solutions**: When one tool isn't enough, we combine websites, applications, and automations into a single system built around your exact requirements.

## About

Ellixorrr deliberately limits itself to four things it does exceptionally well: website development, application development, business automation, and custom solutions. The company works with businesses of every type — from local shops to growing companies — and takes responsibility for what it ships: development, maintenance, and improvement.

## Verification

- The published business facts are the four services and the contact channels listed above.
- No client list, testimonials, reviews, certifications, registrations, or performance statistics are published.
- Portfolio entries are published only with written permission and a verifiable artifact or working demo.
